access_points.name: lid_handle_access
access_points.description: Estimated front-center latch and lift position for the top lid, based on the official closed-unit product photo and the documented 6 cm front-panel protrusion.

access_points.name: loading_access
access_points.description: Estimated top-loading clearance above the rotor chamber center, using the official open-lid height of 85 cm and the open-lid product image.

access_points.name: rear_service_access
access_points.description: Estimated rear service zone for cable, power, and network access, positioned just outside the simplified rear shell so it is reachable without intersecting the body collision.

notes: No usable public CAD, STL, OBJ, GLB, or similar 3D model for the Eppendorf Centrifuge 5910 Ri was found during web search, so this package uses generated fallback geometry.

The mesh assembly uses the official dimensions of 72 x 68 x 37 cm, the official footprint without front panel of 72 x 62 cm, and official closed/open product photos to approximate the recessed body, front control fascia, and top lid proportions.
The front fascia depth is inferred as 6 cm from the difference between the overall depth and the footprint depth without the front panel.
The loading-access and lid-handle frames are estimated from official imagery and should be treated as integration aids rather than measured mechanical datums.

Collision geometry is intentionally modeled as a lower body plus upper shell with a top/front opening corridor, and the rear service access is placed just behind the rear shell to avoid embedding service approaches inside the simplified collision volume.
